meta.name: Brent Crude
meta.source: US Energy Information Administration daily spot via FRED (to 2007-07-29) + Yahoo Finance chart API
meta.sourceNote: Yahoo's continuous front-month contract begins in 2007, so the earlier years are the EIA's daily Europe Brent spot price, public domain. Across 4,692 overlapping days the two diverge by a median of 1.21% (ninth decile 3.76%), a wider seam than WTI's and worth knowing when reading the single join at 2007-07-30.

cpi.basis: US CPI, because this is priced in US dollars

production.source: Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0), compiled from the Energy Institute Statistical Review of World Energy and the US Energy Information Administration
